title: Review explicit any
why: The any type disables static checking for the value and can spread unchecked assumptions through callers.
suggestion: Use a concrete type or unknown with an explicit narrowing check.
limitations: Detects explicit any annotations, assertions, and generic syntax after masking comments and literals; repeated occurrences are grouped per file, and an applicable Biome noExplicitAny rule explicitly set to off suppresses the advisory.
